page.overview:
What is Mastertarium?

Mastertarium is a medley song by Metallica. The medley is a combination of two songs from Master of Puppets.

The medley is a mix of two songs from the album Master of Puppets: the "title track" and "Welcome Home (Sanitarium)".

End of passion play, crumbling away I'm your source of self-destruction Veins that pump with fear, sucking darkest clear Leading on your death's construction

Taste me, you will see More is all you need Dedicated to How I'm killing you
